smartstar_investigation.finding: SmartStar investigation was run autonomously as a scripted test. It demonstrates the CONCEPT of autonomous investigation but is not wired as a repeatable on-demand service.

finding: GFIN investigations are PIPELINE-TRIGGERED (auto on complaint), not BRAIN-DIRECTED. The investigation runs fixed steps (Scam Engine Analysis, Entity Extraction, Connector Search, Police Routing) regardless of gaps or context. SmartStar proves the concept works but the production system doesn't use it.
status: PARTIAL — pipeline autonomous, not Brain-directed autonomous
